verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch ships an official CLI that is documented for use from a terminal 'or through an automated system' to run API tests and automated monitoring. Its `hopp test` command can generate JUnit reports, a CI-friendly output format. missing for 10: no documented CI-platform integration examples (e.g., pipeline configs or exit-code behavior), no independent or hands-on corroboration of headless CI runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: With the command-line interface (CLI) you can interact with the Hoppscotch platform using a terminal, or through an automated system. This enables you to run API tests, manage automated API monitoring
The hopp test command now has the ability to generate a JUnit Report for collection runs in the CLI.
Use the Hoppscotch CLI to run API tests, automate monitoring, and manage collections from your terminal.
